dpo.title: Data Protection
dpo.body: In accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to access, rectify, delete and oppose the processing of your personal data. To exercise these rights, contact us at dpo@manco.paris.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: This website uses cookies strictly necessary for its operation. Audience measurement cookies may be used with your consent. You can manage your preferences via the hu-manity.co widget at the bottom left of your screen.

vote.title: Voting Policy
vote.body: As MANCO.PARIS does not carry out financial management activities on its own behalf, the voting policy as defined by article 321-132 of the AMF General Regulation does not apply to the company.

esg.title: ESG Policy
esg.body: As MANCO.PARIS does not carry out financial management or investment activities on its own behalf, it cannot formally integrate criteria related to social, environmental, or governance objectives. However, MANCO.PARIS pays particular attention to the consideration of these criteria in the investment processes of the management companies to which it delegates fund management.

sfdr.title: Sustainability Risk Policy
sfdr.body: As MANCO.PARIS does not carry out financial management activities on its own behalf, it cannot integrate sustainability risks as such. However, in the context of its service activities for management companies, it ensures that these companies begin to take these risks into account in their investment decisions, particularly risks associated with climate and biodiversity.

remuneration.title: Remuneration Policy
remuneration.body: As MANCO.PARIS does not carry out financial management activities on its own behalf, it cannot integrate sustainability risks into its remuneration policy. However, its employees are encouraged to take sustainability risks into account in their activities.

claims.title: Complaints Handling
claims.body: In accordance with applicable regulatory requirements (cf. art. 321-40 of the AMF General Regulation), MANCO.PARIS has established and maintains an operational procedure for the effective handling of client complaints. Any complaint may be sent to claim@manco.paris, or by post to: MANCO.PARIS, complaints department, 7 rue Roy, 75008 Paris.

conflicts.title: Conflicts of Interest Policy
conflicts.body: MANCO.PARIS takes all necessary measures to detect conflicts of interest situations that may arise in the course of its activities. In accordance with current regulations, MANCO.PARIS has a conflicts of interest management policy. This policy can be obtained upon request from the management company.

bestSelection.title: Best Selection Policy
bestSelection.body: MANCO.PARIS does not carry out financial management activities on its own behalf and therefore does not select financial intermediaries.
